title: sajjad ki milaad ka ye jashne wila hai
body:
sajjad ki milaad ka ye jashne wila hai
qushbu se mehak ti hui mehfil ki fiza hai
<<DIVIDER>>
mushtaq mere waste firdouse ulaa hai
ye sayyade sajjad ki mid'hat ka sila hai
<<DIVIDER>>
masroor ali aur hassan shaad hai be had
shabbir ke gulshan me naya phool khila hai
<<DIVIDER>>
gar bughz hai in se to ibadaat hai bekaar
sajjad ki ulfat me ibadat ka maza hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha raqam azmate sajjad karu mai
wo sabr ka malik hai wo sajdou ka quda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
beemar tere naam se hojata hai acha
sajjad tere isme mubarak me shifa hai
